message.content:
The bug is passing `char` values (which are signed) to `isxdigit`, which expects `int` values representable as `unsigned char` or EOF. When `s[r+1]` or `s[r+2]` has a negative value (high bit set), it's passed as a negative int to `isxdigit`, causing out-of-bounds table indexing.

Answer: 7
